data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Atkines', meaning 'strong' or 'firm'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Atkins usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
